requirements.title: Preserve the foundation and add a versioned overlay
Use explicit prerequisites, sessions, and completion states
Apply a fixed lesson grammar and fade scaffolding
P00 refreshes prerequisite mechanics without awarding intermediate evidence
Module 13 performs a leakage-aware data clinic
Module 14 diagnoses configuration, interruption, and unstable evidence
Module 15 measures uncertainty and performs error analysis
Module 16 establishes a frozen pretrained baseline
Module 17 trains and compares a LoRA adapter
Module 19 packages, imports, and reuses an experiment
Module 20 is an independent applied capstone
Apply an exact capstone rubric without automated competency claims
E01 implements and verifies safe weight tying
E02 builds lexical retrieval with evidence
Insert exact supplement cards without changing lessons 00–12
Keep deterministic feedback separate from assessed reasoning

cases.name: Foundation files remain immutable and overlay is independently versioned
preconditions: Baseline source commit and original content hash manifest are available.
steps: Hash every foundation lesson 00–12 before and after building the intermediate edition.
Inspect the edition manifest and routes.
expected: Every foundation hash is unchanged.
The overlay identifies intermediate-v1 and contains P00,13–20,E01,E02.
Static execution sections say Companion required and do not claim Python ran.

cases.name: Prerequisites and five evidence states remain independent
preconditions: A new v2 learner profile exists.
steps: Open and scroll a new lesson without selecting Mark read.
Select Mark read.
Submit an independent exercise without opening feedback.
Open feedback, then attach valid artifacts and a self assessment.
PATCH progress practiced=true directly; submit an independent_submission; submit a check then a feedback_opened record; PATCH read=false without confirm_reset.
Verify module 14 evidence while module 13 evidence is unverified; open module 14 practice having read but not practiced lesson 07.
expected: Opening and scrolling do not change read state.
Mark read changes only read state.
Submission changes practiced only.
Feedback changes self_checked only after a check submission.
Artifact verification and self review remain separate; self review cannot derive independently_reviewed.

Direct practiced=true returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED reason PROGRESS_DERIVED_FLAG; the submission sets practiced and the check+feedback sets self_checked in the same transactions; read=false without confirm_reset is rejected.
Verification returns 409 STATE_CONFLICT reason PREREQUISITE_NOT_VERIFIED naming module 13; lesson 07 is shown as an advisory prerequisite and blocks nothing.

cases.name: Every new lesson follows grammar and declared fade band
preconditions: All new lesson content is built.
steps: Parse each P00,13–20,E01,E02 lesson heading sequence.
Compare hint/reveal controls with its scaffolding band.

Open module 16's reference answer (feedback_opened) before submitting its independent task; record a prediction linked to a job, start the job, then append a revised prediction; list GET /exercise-records?module_id=16 as an assessor.
expected: All seven required sections occur once and in order.
Hints and early-feedback recording match the module band.
A saved prediction cannot be edited after the associated operation begins.

The submission is stored with feedback_opened_early true; the original prediction is unchanged and the revision has revised_after_job_start true; the assessor list shows all records in creation order; practice and verification are not blocked.

cases.name: P00 oracles pass without required-credit promotion
preconditions: Companion storage is writable.
steps: Submit the shifted-target, invalid-JSONL, and mean answers.
Run prerequisite preflight.
Inspect overall required completion.
expected: Answers match P00-SHIFT, P00-JSONL, and P00-MEAN.
prerequisite_check_v1 records environment and storage checks.
P00 contributes zero required modules.

cases.name: Clean and leaky fixtures produce fixed audit outcomes
preconditions: Canonical data fixtures are installed.
steps: Audit data-clinic-v1.
Audit data-clinic-leaky-v1.
Attempt to select leaky fixture for compute.
expected: Clean counts are 24/12/12 with zero exact, near, or group leakage.
Leaky counts are exactly 1,2,1.
Compute selection of the leaky fixture is rejected without a job.

cases.name: Diagnosis exercise produces deterministic safe interruption
preconditions: tiny-v2-diagnosis-v1 is installed.
steps: Submit width 63/heads 4.
Run clean tiny_train.
Run diagnostic fields with hold step 25 and cancel at cancellable_hold.
Resume the step 25 checkpoint.
Repeat once without cancelling for 10 minutes.

Render diagnosis-traces-v1 D14-01..D14-05 and compare each with the product's real shapes: a 400 envelope for D14-01/02, a failed job whose error.code is NONFINITE_TRAINING_VALUE as produced by AC-APP-019, matching the D14-03 event shape.
expected: Invalid config creates no job.
Cancellation returns interrupted with checkpoint step 25.
Resume starts from step 25 under a new identity.
Timeout returns interrupted/exercise_timeout and never continues training.
Every trace shape is one the product can emit; oracle labels are unchanged; no trace imports as a recorded run.

cases.name: Three-seed evaluation freezes selection before test
preconditions: Module14 is artifact_verified and test split unused.
steps: Run seeds 17,23,31 for 100 updates under one profile.
Freeze lowest-validation checkpoint per seed using earliest-step tie break.
Evaluate test once per checkpoint.
Recompute aggregate/spread and worst-three records.
For each seed read TinyTrainResult.best_checkpoint_id and evaluate it with subject {kind: tiny_checkpoint, checkpoint_id}; include a run whose best checkpoint is not the final step.
expected: All non-seed settings and dataset hashes match.
Selection timestamps precede test jobs.
NLL-per-byte arithmetic and sample standard deviation match within 1e-12.
Worst-three ordering uses descending value then record_id.

The evaluated checkpoint equals the run's best_checkpoint_id (lowest validation token NLL, earliest step on ties) even when it is not last_checkpoint_id; subject_identity binds that checkpoint's manifest digest.

cases.name: Pretrained baseline is prepared explicitly and evaluated unchanged
preconditions: Network is available and no baseline is prepared.
steps: Inspect and approve model_prepare.
Evaluate all 12 applied-intents-v1 test records using applied-intents-greedy-v1.
Compare file digests before and after.
expected: Prepared identity is the pinned repository revision.
Exactly 12 ordered records and all overall/per-slice metrics are retained.
Base digests are unchanged and no quality threshold is applied.

cases.name: Adapter train/resume and baseline comparison preserve the base
preconditions: Module16 base and baseline evidence exist.
steps: Run adapter_train to step 40.
Resume for 20 updates.
Select by validation and evaluate base plus adapter on identical test inputs.
expected: Only q_proj and v_proj LoRA parameters are trainable.
Resume ends step 60 with parent lineage and optimizer/RNG state.
Base digests remain unchanged.
Paired metrics recompute; improvement is not required.

cases.name: Continuation, chat serialization, and truncation remain distinct
preconditions: A tiny checkpoint, prepared base, and adapter exist.
steps: Call generate on tiny.
Call chat_generate on base and adapter.
Run both chat fixtures.
Compare model digests and dataset registry before/after.
expected: Tiny uses plain continuation only.
No-truncation drops nothing.
Drop-oldest removes exactly the oldest complete user-assistant pair and retains system/latest user.
Weights are unchanged and chat history is not registered as training data.

cases.name: Bundle validates, imports into clean storage, deduplicates, and reproduces
preconditions: A complete experiment and a second empty storage root exist on the same profile.
steps: Record fixed greedy inference.
Export and validate bundle.
Import to empty root and repeat inference.
Import identical bundle again.
Change one archive byte and validate/import it.

In root B run export-reuse-receipt after validate, import, duplicate-skip import, tampered validation and reuse inference; in root A run register-reuse-receipt with that file; verify CUR-011 in root A; register a receipt whose bundle_sha256 was not exported by root A.
expected: Read-only validation performs no registration.
Imported objects receive local identities and preserve immutable lineage without source absolute paths.
Second import follows duplicate policy without duplicate bytes.
Tampered bundle mutates nothing.
Token IDs and stop reason match same-profile source inference.

The receipt validates against reuse-receipt.schema.json and registers as an immutable reuse_receipt artifact; CUR-011 reaches artifact_verified in root A with output token IDs equal to the source inference; the foreign receipt returns VALIDATION_FAILED reason REUSE_RECEIPT_MISMATCH and registers nothing.

cases.name: Capstone seals candidates and consumes one paired test release per attempt
preconditions: Required prior artifacts exist and capstone-support-v1 test is unreleased for attempt 1.
steps: Save a precompute plan.
Freeze baseline and selected candidate using validation.
Confirm atomic paired test evaluation.
Try to reuse its token.
Start a new attempt after a simulated failed first paired job.

Create attempt A1, then try to create A2 while A1 is available; abandon A1 and create A2 (prior_abandoned); consume A2 with a queued evaluate and cancel it while queued; create A3 (prior_cancelled) and complete it; create A4 (new_experiment, different candidate) and complete it; replay A3's create request with its Idempotency-Key; download A3's evaluate request artifact.
Complete the capstone reuse step through the same receipt flow and verify CUR-012 in root A with FOUNDATION-12 and CUR-005..011 verified there.
Complete a capstone whose candidate fails exactly one record; inspect the worst-three list.

Let the first capstone attempt's paired evaluation fail after consuming its token (shortened-clock deadline), create a second attempt with reason prior_failed and complete it, then create and complete a third attempt with reason new_experiment.
expected: Subjects are ordered baseline then candidate and use identical 12 records/settings.
Token is consumed before loading and cannot be reused.
Failure remains linked and immutable.
New attempt has new IDs/token and visible prior_release_count/Previously released label.
All 10 evidence checklist items retain immutable references.

A2 while A1 open returns 409 ATTEMPT_ALREADY_OPEN; abandoned A1 never consumed and leaves prior_release_count unaffected; A2 is consumed by the queued cancel (outcome interrupted); A3 records prior_release_count 1 and reused_test at consumption; A3 is the CUR-012 evaluation and A4 is labelled exploration (reused_test) that cannot satisfy checklist item 6; the replay returns 409 SECRET_ALREADY_DELIVERED; the request artifact contains token_sha256 and no release_token.
CUR-012 reaches artifact_verified in a single registry; reuse facts are labelled receipt-asserted (learner-carried, digest-bound).
Worst three are the candidate's records ordered by exact_intent_match, response_schema_valid, record_id; positions two and three are labelled no_failure.

The second attempt is labelled 'Reused test · counts as the capstone comparison' and satisfies checklist item 6; the third is labelled 'Exploration · reused test · does not count for the capstone'; the rubric's Evaluation discipline row cannot score 10 for the second attempt.

cases.name: Rubric arithmetic and assessor labels do not imply certification
preconditions: One artifact-verified capstone packet and rubric submissions exist.
steps: Apply a self rubric totaling 85 with no zero.
Apply an independent rubric totaling 75.
Inspect labels/history.

With CUR-012 packet complete, store a self assessment decision partially_meets, then an independent meets, then a self does_not_meet; read the evidence record after each; post an assessment to CUR-011 evidence.
expected: Self result renders Self-reviewed and derives review_status self_reviewed only.
Independent result totaling 75 does not meet the published threshold.
Both histories remain; no certification/intermediate-user claim appears.

completion_status moves packet_complete_not_meeting, completed_independently_reviewed, packet_complete_not_meeting; review_status stays independently_reviewed once set; latest_decision tracks the latest assessment; each assessment stores evidence_revision; the CUR-011 assessment returns 400 SEMANTIC_INVALID.

cases.name: Weight tying is confined, tested, and checkpoint explicit
preconditions: E01 workspace is created from tiny-v2.
steps: Implement allowed alias.
Run all six checks.
Run 50 updates.
Attempt incompatible untied checkpoint load.
expected: Foundation files are unchanged.
Parameter delta is 16448 and weights share object identity.
Shape, finite loss, causality, and save/load checks pass.
Incompatible load fails explicitly.
No loss threshold is used.

cases.name: TF-IDF retrieval and citation support match fixed oracle
preconditions: retrieval-manual-v1 is installed.
steps: Build one index.
Run RQ01–RQ06 with k3.
Submit citations.
Run an out-of-vocabulary query.
expected: All top-three orders and required supporting citations match E02-RANKING.
No-vocabulary query fails.
No model or adapter weight changes.
Earlier query artifacts retain their original index identity after rebuild.

cases.name: Supplement cards bind exact anchors and routes
preconditions: Foundation Markdown and overlay fixture exist.
steps: Resolve every exact heading occurrence and destination.
Introduce a missing heading in a disposable test copy.
Inspect card-click progress.
expected: Eleven cards resolve after the declared sections in order.
Missing/duplicate anchor fails build without fallback.
Routes use #/learn/moduleId.
Click changes no progress state.

cases.name: Objective checks, rubric judgments, and failures remain distinct
preconditions: One valid, one invalid, and one infrastructure-failed submission exist.
steps: Run objective verification.
Open explanation assessment.
Regrade after publishing a new oracle version.
expected: Objective failure names rule/value/artifact.
Infrastructure-dependent checks are NOT_RUN.
Machine does not grade prose judgments.
Old submissions retain old oracle identity and attempt history.

cases.name: Static progress remains local and exposes no companion evidence mutation
preconditions: A new v2 learner profile is open in static mode.
steps: Open and scroll a lesson.
Select Mark read, submit its independent exercise, and submit a feedback check.
Inspect artifact-verification and independent-review controls.
expected: Opening and scrolling change no state.
Mark read, practiced, and self_checked change only their independent local dimensions.
Artifact verification and independent review are unavailable and display Requires the local companion; static mode cannot create artifact_verified or independently_reviewed state.

cases.name: Static assessment view preserves labels without promoting imported claims
preconditions: Static mode has a read-only imported claim and the capstone rubric fixture available for display.
steps: Inspect the imported evidence label, rubric labels, and unavailable objective-verification and rubric-mutation actions.
In static mode attempt to save a scored rubric for any evidence.
expected: The imported item remains Imported claim · not reviewed.
Self-reviewed and Independently reviewed appear only as explanatory rubric labels.
Objective verification and rubric mutation display Requires the local companion; no artifact_verified, self_reviewed, or independently_reviewed status is created.
No assessment is stored; the learner may save an unscored reflection note; no self_reviewed status is created.

cases.name: Module evidence verifier dispatch and prerequisite closure
preconditions: Every mapping role has actual locally produced artifacts; imported foundation records present separately.
steps: Verify each module using contracts/evidence-verification.md rules.
Repeat with one missing, ambiguous, extra and checksum-mismatched artifact per profile.
Try original lab-import claims as foundation gate; then execute required companion foundation operations.
Assess totals 80/no zero/gates true, 85/one zero, 100/gates false, 50 and 45.
Send an assessment whose client decision disagrees with the derivation; send one that includes total_score; import a backup whose evidence claims artifact_verified with claim_status imported_claim.

For module 15 submit the twelve anchors (three tiny_train request artifacts, three checkpoint manifests, three evaluation metrics, three records); resubmit with a run's metrics artifact added as a thirteenth ID; compare stored verification_checks IDs with contracts/evidence-roles.json.
expected: Roles derive from immutable registry relations, not filenames or narrative claims.
Imported claims never become local execution proof; missing runtime dependencies stay NOT_RUN.
Meets only for gates + >=80 + no zero; otherwise partially_meets if >=50 and does_not_meet below 50.

Decision mismatch returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED at field decision; client total_score is an unknown property (SCHEMA_INVALID); the imported record is rejected with SEMANTIC_INVALID by EVIDENCE_IMPORT_STATE.
Twelve anchors verify; the extra non-anchor ID returns 400 SEMANTIC_INVALID naming it as unconsumed; every stored check_id is listed for the profile in evidence-roles.json.

cases.name: Module 17 device comparison runs one job on CPU and GPU, or reads the supplied snapshot
preconditions: Module 16 evidence exists.
Live rows: a machine with a supported GPU and both OS environments installed. Supplied rows: no CUDA environment, and the sealed device-comparison-reference-v1 snapshot present.
steps: Save the M17-DEVICE prediction, then submit the independent task's 40-update adapter_train request from the CPU environment and from the CUDA environment against one root.
Open the module 17 device comparison and verify evidence intermediate-adapter-comparison-v1.
On the machine without a CUDA environment, open the device comparison before and after saving the prediction, then verify evidence.
Verify evidence with two CPU runs, with a pair whose seeds differ, and with a prediction saved after the first comparison job left queued.
expected: The table shows each run's device and profile, elapsed seconds at update 40, peak resident memory, peak reserved CUDA memory for the GPU run only, per-update losses 1 to 40 with absolute differences and their maximum, validation metrics at updates 0, 10, 20, 30 and 40, and each selected update; every value recomputes from the metrics artifacts; both runs are labelled Local companion job.
Check intermediate-adapter-comparison-v1.013 passes; no speed, memory or equality threshold is applied; the metrics rows carry peak resident bytes and, on the CUDA run, peak reserved CUDA bytes.

The snapshot is hidden until the prediction record exists, then shown with its reference machine and labelled Recorded result · supplied snapshot; .013 passes on the exercise record naming the snapshot and its sealed SHA-256.
Each mismatched submission fails .013; the late prediction has revised_after_job_start true.
